verdict.rationale: Stripe states it handles KYC verification and sanctions screening for onramp customers, and stablecoin payouts run through Connect connected accounts, where recipients link wallets in the Express Dashboard. That is Stripe-managed, implied counterparty onboarding rather than documented KYC/KYB endpoints an ops team calls. Recipients paid in crypto are also limited to individuals and sole proprietors, so there is no KYB path for businesses. Missing for 10: documented KYC/KYB API endpoints or flows for stablecoin senders and recipients, business (KYB) recipient support, explicit verification-status gating before funds move, and independent corroboration.
